Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.remediation_run_states.devices
Metrics.Description: Intune proactive-remediation device run states, counted by remediation, detection state and remediation state; per-device detail (device, OS, the detection script's output) on the intune.remediation_run_states log twin.
